description: GET /v1/doctor with a valid token. This fixture harness starts the control server without a platform root, so the installation section reports itself unavailable rather than reading a receipt, and the platform section's health check fails because the fixture host's healthUrl is unreachable — both are exactly what doctor.InspectInstallation/InspectPlatform report given that input, reused unchanged by the control channel.

checks.detail: The control channel was started without a platform root.
The health document cannot be read.
checks.hint: Run "kb-create restart"; read the host log if it persists.
